title: Self-Steering Optimization: Autonomous Preference Optimization for Large Language Models
authors_zh: Hao Xiang, Bowen Yu, Hongyu Lin, Keming Lu, Yaojie Lu, Xianpei Han, Ben He, Le Sun, Jingren Zhou, Junyang Lin
paper_type_zh: 自动偏好数据生成研究
best_for_zh: 适合设计自生成偏好数据、并需要同时控制回答对正确性和被拒绝回答在目标策略下概率的读者。
one_line: Self-Steering Optimization trains a policy-derived generator to synthesize accurate, near-on-policy preference pairs for later preference optimization.
Self-Steering Optimization 训练一个源自策略模型的生成器，为后续偏好优化合成准确且接近 on-policy 的偏好对。
why: It makes response-distribution control part of the preference-record construction stage instead of assuming that principle prompting alone yields trainable pairs.
inclusion_reason: It alters the generator that creates chosen and rejected responses so preference records are both accurate and close to the policy distribution before optimization.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Automated alignment needs preference pairs, but simply prompting a model to be good or bad can yield pairs with the wrong ordering or rejected answers far outside the policy distribution. A correct but off-policy negative response receives little useful negative-gradient signal, while an on-policy but wrongly ordered pair can move the model in the wrong direction.

The paper asks how to generate preference records that are simultaneously accurate and near on-policy without human labels or an external reward model. It separates data generation from final alignment: a policy-derived generator is first optimized to control the distributions of good and rejected responses, then its pairs train the policy through a standard preference objective.

自动对齐需要偏好对，但仅仅提示模型表现得好或坏，可能产生顺序错误的回答对，或产生远离策略分布的被拒绝回答。一个正确却离策略很远的负回答只能提供很少有用的负梯度信号，而一个仍在策略上的错误排序回答对会将模型推向错误方向。

论文要回答的是，如何在无需人工标签或外部奖励模型的情况下生成同时准确且接近 on-policy 的偏好记录。它把数据生成与最终对齐分开：先优化一个源自策略的生成器以控制好回答和被拒绝回答的分布，再用其生成的回答对通过标准偏好目标训练策略。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
For each query, a principle generator writes contrastive good and bad principles. The policy-derived generator answers the query with each principle and also without a principle, producing a good response, a bad response, and an original response. The original answer is important because it anchors the rejected-response objective near what the policy would naturally produce.

SSO trains that generator with two linked terms. One separates good and rejected responses so the pair is accurate; the other makes the original response preferable to the good response under the bad-principle query, preventing the rejected distribution from being pushed into an implausible low-probability region. Only after this data-generation stage are the resulting pairs given to DPO or another xPO consumer.

对于每个问题，一个原则生成器写出相互对照的好原则和坏原则。源自策略的生成器分别带着两种原则回答问题，并在不带原则时再回答一次，从而产生好回答、坏回答和原始回答。原始回答很重要，因为它把被拒绝回答的目标锚定在策略自然会产生的内容附近。

SSO 用两个相连的项训练该生成器。一个拉开好回答与被拒绝回答的距离以保证回答对准确；另一个让原始回答在坏原则问题下优于好回答，避免被拒绝分布被推到不可信的低概率区域。只有在此数据生成阶段之后，得到的回答对才交给 DPO 或其他 xPO 消费者。

title: Method
方法
html:
The main experiments use Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct to write principles, then use Qwen2-7B or Llama3-8B SFT or instruct models as the policy and generator. For a query x, the good and bad principles are system messages forming two conditioned queries; the generator samples their answers and an unconditioned answer. The good loss combines a base preference loss with SFT on the good answer.

The rejected-side loss is deliberately not the symmetric bad-answer loss. It applies the base loss to the bad query, original answer, and good answer, plus SFT on the original answer, so bad conditioning does not force an unnatural response. The authors optimize the generator on 8K UltraFeedback queries, sample with temperature 0.7 and top-p 0.8, and align the policy on the full 60K-query collection with DPO in the main setup.

主要实验使用 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 撰写原则，再以 Qwen2-7B 或 Llama3-8B 的监督微调版或指令版作为策略和生成器。对于问题 x，好原则和坏原则作为系统消息形成两个条件问题；生成器采样其回答以及一个无条件回答。好回答损失将基础偏好损失与好回答上的监督微调损失结合。

被拒绝侧的损失有意不采用对称的坏回答损失。它把基础损失施加于坏问题、原始回答和好回答，并在原始回答上加入监督微调损失，从而避免坏条件迫使模型输出不自然的内容。作者在 8K 条 UltraFeedback 问题上优化生成器，以温度 0.7 和 top-p 0.8 抽样，并在主要设置中用 DPO 对全量 6 万条问题的策略进行对齐。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On Qwen2-7B SFT, SSO-DPO reports AlpacaEval length-controlled win rate 43.0 and MT-Bench 8.66, compared with 37.7 and 8.59 for principle-based DPO. On Llama3-8B SFT, it reports 35.0 and 7.96 versus 29.5 and 7.92. It also improves some objective evaluations, although the paper does not claim a consistent MMLU gain.

For reward modeling, a Llama3-8B-Instruct model trained on 60K SSO pairs scores 80.0 average on RewardBench, above 79.5 for UltraFeedback and 78.9 for principle-based pairs. Mixing its synthetic pairs with Skywork-Reward-Preference-80K-v0.2 reaches 86.3 versus 84.5 for Skywork alone. A 200-query GPT-4 analysis reports improved pair accuracy and average response probability, but is limited evidence for those construction claims.

在 Qwen2-7B 监督微调版上，SSO-DPO 报告 AlpacaEval 长度控制胜率为 43.0、MT-Bench 为 8.66，而原则式 DPO 分别为 37.7 和 8.59。在 Llama3-8B 监督微调版上，它报告 35.0 和 7.96，而原则式 DPO 为 29.5 和 7.92。它也改善了一些客观评测，尽管论文没有宣称 MMLU 有稳定提升。

对于奖励建模，使用 6 万条 SSO 回答对训练的 Llama3-8B-Instruct 在 RewardBench 上平均为 80.0，高于 UltraFeedback 的 79.5 和原则式回答对的 78.9。将其合成回答对与 Skywork-Reward-Preference-80K-v0.2 混合后达到 86.3，而单独 Skywork 为 84.5。一项对 200 个问题的 GPT-4 分析报告了更高的回答对准确性和平均回答概率，但这只是对构造主张的有限证据。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The new contribution is a data-generator objective, not simply another direct-preference loss. It treats the likelihood of the rejected response under the target policy as part of what makes a preference record usable. This connects pair quality to the gradient signal the policy will actually receive during later optimization.

Principle prompting previously supplied an easy way to obtain contrastive answers, but did not control whether the bad answer was plausibly on policy. SSO adds an unconditioned response and asymmetric rejected-side objective to make that control explicit. The record construction therefore includes a learned distributional constraint before DPO sees any chosen/rejected pair.

新的贡献是一种数据生成器目标，而不只是另一种直接偏好损失。它把被拒绝回答在目标策略下的似然视为使偏好记录可用的一部分。这将回答对质量与策略在后续优化中实际收到的梯度信号连接起来。

原则提示此前提供了获得对照回答的简便方式，却没有控制坏回答是否仍合理地属于策略分布。SSO 加入无条件回答和非对称的被拒绝侧目标，使这种控制变得明确。因此，在 DPO 看到任何偏好／非偏好回答对之前，记录构造已经包含一个学习得到的分布约束。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The synthetic-pair accuracy evidence relies on GPT-4 judgments of 200 samples, and the method still needs a principle generator whose quality can affect the data. Improvements are smaller for already aligned models and not uniform across objective benchmarks. The reported data come mainly from UltraFeedback and English alignment tasks, so transfer to other languages, domains, and safety policies is unproven. No official code, model, or generated dataset is declared, and the licenses of the prompts, models, generator output, and external judge must be checked before reuse.
合成回答对准确性的证据依赖 GPT-4 对 200 个样本的判断，而且该方法仍需要一个质量会影响数据的原则生成器。对于已经对齐的模型，改进更小，且在客观基准上并不一致。报告的数据主要来自 UltraFeedback 和英文对齐任务，因此向其他语言、领域和安全政策的迁移尚未得到证明。论文没有声明官方代码、模型或生成数据集，复用前还必须检查提示、模型、生成器输出和外部评判器的许可证。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: This is essential for builders of synthetic preference data because it identifies a failure mode that pairwise accuracy alone misses: a negative answer can be too unlikely for DPO to learn from. The paper gives a concrete three-response record and a generator-versus-policy separation that can be audited in other pipelines. Use it when the target policy can sample its own candidates and reference-free quality control is needed, but validate pair ordering, likelihood, principle quality, and safety behavior with independent checks.
对于合成偏好数据的构建者，这是一篇必读论文，因为它指出了仅看回答对准确性会遗漏的失败模式：一个负回答可能过于不可能，以至于 DPO 无法从中学习。论文给出可在其他流程中审计的三回答记录和生成器与策略分离方案。当目标策略能够自行采样候选、且需要无参考质量控制时可以使用它，但应通过独立检查验证回答对排序、似然、原则质量和安全行为。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read Sections 4 and 6 together. Section 4 explains why the rejected-side loss uses the original response rather than the sampled bad response, and Section 6 tests that asymmetric decision against a symmetric alternative. Table 1 measures policy performance, Table 2 shows that the same generated records can train a reward model, and Figure 3 is only a small judge-based audit of pair quality. When reproducing, keep generator and final policy checkpoints distinct; the SSO loss trains the former, while DPO or IPO trains the latter.
应将第 4 节与第 6 节结合阅读。第 4 节解释为何被拒绝侧损失使用原始回答而非采样的坏回答，第 6 节则将这一非对称决定与对称替代方案进行检验。表 1 衡量策略性能，表 2 表明相同生成记录也可训练奖励模型，而图 3 只是一个小规模、基于评判器的回答对质量审计。复现时应保持生成器和最终策略的检查点不同；SSO 损失训练前者，而 DPO 或 IPO 训练后者。
